note: The Americas (美洲): hand-written places, one node or edge per line. See docs/places.md.

name: Texas
intro: Land of the Comanche and other peoples; Spanish, then Mexican, independent as the Republic of Texas in 1836 and part of the United States from 1845.
intro_zh: 原住民科曼奇等族的土地，先后属西班牙、墨西哥，1836年独立为得克萨斯共和国，1845年并入美国。

name: California
intro: Home to many native peoples; Spain built missions here in the 1700s; then Mexican, and American after the Mexican–American War in 1848.
intro_zh: 原住民部落众多，十八世纪西班牙在此建传教站，后属墨西哥，1848年美墨战争后归美国。

name: Falkland Islands / Malvinas
name_zh: 福克兰群岛 / 马尔维纳斯群岛
